purchase.help: If true, the packaging can be used for purchase orders

purchase_method.help:
On ordered quantities: Control bills based on ordered quantities.
On received quantities: Control bills based on received quantities.

date_order.help: Depicts the date within which the Quotation should be confirmed and converted into a purchase order.

date_planned.help: Delivery date promised by vendor. This date is used to determine expected arrival of products.

dest_address_id.help: Put an address if you want to deliver directly from the vendor to the customer. Otherwise, keep empty to deliver to your own company.

incoterm_id.help: International Commercial Terms are a series of predefined commercial terms used in international transactions.

mail_reception_confirmed.help: True if PO reception is confirmed by the vendor.

mail_reception_declined.help: True if PO reception is declined by the vendor.

mail_reminder_confirmed.help: True if the reminder email is confirmed by the vendor.

origin.help: Reference of the document that generated this purchase order request (e.g. a sales order)

partner_id.help: You can find a vendor by its Name, TIN, Email or Internal Reference.

partner_ref.help: Reference of the sales order or bid sent by the vendor. It's used to do the matching when you receive the products as this reference is usually written on the delivery order sent by your vendor.

tax_country_id.help: Technical field to filter the available taxes depending on the fiscal country and fiscal position.

date_planned.help: Delivery date expected from vendor. This date respectively defaults to vendor pricelist lead time then today's date.

product_no_variant_attribute_value_ids.string: Product attribute values that do not create variants

qty_received_method.help:
According to product configuration, the received quantity can be automatically computed by mechanism:
  - Manual: the quantity is set manually on the line
  - Stock Moves: the quantity comes from confirmed pickings

delay.help: Amount of time between purchase approval and order by date.

delay_pass.help: Amount of time between date planned and order by date for each purchase order line.

po_double_validation.help: Provide a double validation mechanism for purchases
selection: Confirm purchase orders in one step
Get 2 levels of approvals to confirm a purchase order

po_double_validation_amount.help: Minimum amount for which a double validation is required

po_lead.help: Margin of error for vendor lead times. When the system generates Purchase Orders for procuring products, they will be scheduled that many days earlier to cope with unexpected vendor delays.

po_lock.help: Purchase Order Modification used when you want to purchase order editable after confirm
selection: Confirmed purchase orders are not editable

default_purchase_method.help: This default value is applied to any new product created. This can be changed in the product detail form.

group_send_reminder.help: Allow automatically send email to remind your vendor the receipt date

use_po_lead.help: Margin of error for vendor lead times. When the system generates Purchase Orders for reordering products,they will be scheduled that many days earlier to cope with unexpected vendor delays.

property_purchase_currency_id.help: This currency will be used, instead of the default one, for purchases from the current partner

receipt_reminder_email.help: Automatically send a confirmation email to the vendor X days before the expected receipt date, asking him to confirm the exact date.

reminder_date_before_receipt.help: Number of days to send reminder email before the promised receipt date
